key_idea: The torn piece must have the right borders and the road in the right place.
steps: The missing part is the top right corner of the map.
So the piece needs a blue border along its top and along its right side.
The green road runs into the torn corner near the top, so on the piece it must come in from the left side, near the top.
Piece C has borders on the top and the right, and its road comes in from the left near the top.

choice_feedback.A: The borders fit, but the road is too low. It is near the bottom of the piece.
choice_feedback.B: This piece has borders on the left and the bottom, so it is a bottom left corner.
choice_feedback.D: Here the road goes down from the top, but on the map it comes in from the left.
choice_feedback.E: This piece is a triangle, but the torn corner is a square.
